dct_description_sm:
Aggregate statistics from the 1991 census of population and households. Tables include univariate and some bi-variate tables on age, sex, migration, birthplace and ethnic origin, housing and tenure, household composition, family composition, travel to work and hours worked, education, and labour force activity by occupation and industry.

Population present on census night; resident population and area.

dct_title_s: Census of population [Great Britain] 1991: key statistics for local authorities
